❓ Frequently asked questions

What does SMOG stand for?

Simple Measure of Gobbledygook — created by G. Harry McLaughlin in 1969. It is widely used for healthcare and consumer-safety documents.

How is SMOG calculated?

SMOG = 1.043 × √(polysyllables × 30 / sentences) + 3.1291, where polysyllables are words of 3 or more syllables.

Why 30 sentences?

The formula is calibrated for a 30-sentence sample. With fewer sentences the result is an approximation, which this tool labels honestly.
